title: Implement fused physical Gaussian coefficient arithmetic
body:
I implement fused Gaussian C/inverse-C components, encoded complete-axis traversal and aligned signed ADD/subtraction with a fixed physical tape inventory. I use bounded carry and sign extension to check exact halving and final signed fit, without materializing unhalved h-bit numerators. At three bits, for example, I accept the valid `C(3+3i,3+3i)` endpoint despite its wider staged sum.

I prove the component acceptance conditions and give the full movement, setup, disposal and space argument in `research/physical-gaussian-leaf/PROOF.md`: O(V) per complete axis and aligned ADD, O(fV) for a direct f-axis leaf. I preserve borrowed operands, close owned work, and check nested caller handoffs with live parent Counts. I retain the direct-leaf stopping predicate; I leave faster nonleaf recursion and caller alignment outside this contribution.

I passed eight registered cold commands on Python 3.12.13/macOS arm64 by 23:36 UTC: 37,640 C-row cases, 1,124 signed sums/differences, complete spaced/tensor packets, one-through-eight-axis sharp-reserve impulses, named rejection/reuse, nested handoffs and eight injected faults. Word/failure checks also passed with assertions disabled.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-gaussian-leaf
```

I retain Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales's #45 Gaussian parity/tensor reserve and norm results, James Chang's #1869 ripple adder, AAAmirinu's #2327 staged prefix audit, ywz65's #2534 selected-child fixture, and Nick Petalas's #2772/#3089 prefix/capacity work. #2287 supplies the grid/operator convention; #3055/#3087 and their retained sources supply the physical tape framework. I preserve frozen notices and pin 20 live inputs. The concurrent #3090 scalar-capacity result remains complementary.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including analysis subagents. I claim no new denominator theorem, complete selected caller, independent verification or multiplication exponent. I leave the selected frontier unchanged.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-18984596
